Title: Migrations package missing and schema drift
Evidence: loans/migrations and payments/migrations have no __init__.py; clean migrate creates no loans/payments tables; model fields paystack_authorization_url and paystack_access_code absent from 0001
Impact: No loan or payment endpoint can work on a fresh deploy; schema and code disagree
Fix: Add __init__.py, generate 0002 migrations, replay on empty DB, add CI migration check

Title: No reliable server-side payment fulfilment
Evidence: paystack_webhook is not routed in core/urls.py; handles no charge.success; verifies with PAYSTACK_WEBHOOK_SECRET instead of the secret key
Impact: Customer can pay and never be disbursed if the browser closes; money taken without fulfilment
Fix: Route webhook, verify HMAC-SHA512 with secret key, persist events, handle charge.success and transfer events

Title: Host and origin configuration contradicts deployment
Evidence: render service loan-platform-backend; ALLOWED_HOSTS only loan-platform.onrender.com; env vars for hosts/CSRF/CORS/DEBUG never read; frontend hardcodes an API host
Impact: DisallowedHost 400 or CORS failure in production, staging and previews
Fix: Read all hosts from env, use relative /api, add staging config and tests

Title: Truthy secret placeholders committed in render.yaml
Evidence: DJANGO_SECRET_KEY set to literal placeholder; settings accepts any non-empty value
Impact: If deployed unchanged, the JWT signing key is public and tokens can be forged
Fix: Use sync:false/generateValue, rotate keys, reject placeholders at boot, add secret scanning

Title: Photo registration impossible in deployed build
Evidence: Backend/requirements.txt omits supabase; SUPABASE_URL and SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY not declared in render.yaml; UI requires three photos
Impact: No user can complete signup on Render
Fix: Add pinned supabase dependency, declare env vars, add readiness check and e2e test

Title: Fee schedule has gaps and wrong exception type
Evidence: 7992 of 59001 amounts have no tier; compute_service_fee raises ValidationError but view catches ValueError; 2541 numbers rejected by loans.normalize_ke_phone
Impact: HTTP 500 for valid amounts and for all Airtel 01X users
Fix: Make schedule contiguous, add quote endpoint, unify normalization, add range tests

Title: Dashboard cannot read the active-loan API
Evidence: API returns has_active_loan and nested loan; dashboard checks has_loan and reads flat fields; disbursed loans excluded
Impact: Loan never displays; user sees no confirmation or history
Fix: One response schema, contract tests, add loan history endpoint

Title: Identity documents are public and unconsented
Evidence: get_public_url stores permanent URLs; service-role key; plaintext ID; no consent, retention, access log or DPA registration
Impact: Permanent exposure of national IDs and selfies; DPA 2019 breach
Fix: Private bucket, paths only, signed URLs, consent, retention, access audit, DPIA

Title: Fee taken before approval with no refunds or terms
Evidence: ApplyLoanView charges before any decision; APPROVED means fee paid; no refund, term, APR or agreement
Impact: Consumer pays and may receive nothing; unenforceable product
Fix: Approve first, deduct fee from principal, add offer/acceptance, refunds and terms

Title: Disbursement marked complete on initiation and cannot retry
Evidence: transfer.initiated set before the call; DISBURSED set immediately; verify returns already_verified on failure
Impact: Permanent stuck loans; false status; double-payout risk
Fix: Explicit states, intent persisted before call, no external calls in transaction, retry job

Title: Unsupported licensed-and-regulated claim
Evidence: index.html states licensed and regulated; no entity, licence number, address or policy pages
Impact: Misrepresentation and consumer-protection risk; trust damage
Fix: Remove claim until true; publish entity, licence, terms, privacy and complaints

Title: Failed disbursement has no recovery path
Evidence: initiated=True before transfer; failure leaves all future attempts skipped
Impact: Customer paid, loan stuck at APPROVED, no ops action
Fix: Add DISBURSEMENT_FAILED state, retry with bounded attempts, ops action

Title: No reconciliation with Paystack
Evidence: No job verifies pending references or compares settlements
Fix: Scheduled reconciliation, mismatch alerts, daily settlement report

Title: No refunds reversals or disputes
Evidence: No refund model or endpoint; transfer.reversed only writes last_event
Fix: Refund service, reversal handling, reserves, policy

Title: Verification checks amount only
Evidence: VerifyPaymentView compares amount but not currency, reference, metadata or customer
Impact: Wrong-currency or mismatched transactions could pass
Fix: Check all fields against the Payment record

Title: No idempotency keys
Evidence: Retries reuse references; lost responses can strand users with duplicate-reference errors
Fix: Persist idempotency keys; fetch existing transaction on retry

Title: Fake email domain and no receipts
Evidence: Internal address user-phone@example.com; no email or SMS receipt
Impact: No proof of payment; support burden
Fix: Collect real email or send SMS receipts

Title: Treasury and settlement risk
Evidence: Transfer from balance immediately after collection; no buffer; payout and collection fees not modelled
Impact: Failed payouts at launch and negative unit economics
Fix: Treasury buffer, T+1 payout, fee model, balance alerts

Title: No ledger
Evidence: Payment and Transfer are mutable status rows

Title: No currency and integer money
Evidence: Amounts are PositiveIntegerField; currency hardcoded in places
Fix: Decimal money type, currency field, single money module

Title: JWT in localStorage with no refresh or revocation
Evidence: auth.js stores access token in localStorage; 30-minute TTL; no refresh or logout-all
Impact: XSS token theft; session expiry mid-flow
Fix: httpOnly cookies or refresh rotation with token versioning

Title: No rate limits or bot protection
Evidence: THROTTLE env vars unused; no DRF throttles or CAPTCHA
Impact: Credential stuffing, spam registrations, storage abuse
Fix: DRF throttles, CAPTCHA, per-phone and per-IP quotas

Title: Account enumeration
Evidence: Login returns distinct messages for unknown phone and wrong password
Fix: Generic invalid-credentials message and constant-time path

Title: No password reset or validators
Evidence: No reset/change flow; only minimum length; Django validators not enabled

Title: Phone ownership never verified
Evidence: Registration requires no OTP; phone is the unique identity
Fix: OTP at signup and before payout-number changes

Title: Admin exposed without 2FA or throttling
Evidence: /admin/ public; no 2FA, IP restriction or login throttling
Impact: Staff takeover equals full data breach

Title: Public debug endpoint
Evidence: /debug-env/ returns configuration booleans to anyone

Title: PII in logs
Evidence: Phone numbers and gateway errors logged at INFO

Title: Third-party payment script without SRI or CSP
Evidence: Paystack inline loaded from CDN; inline scripts; no CSP; no redirect fallback
Impact: Supply-chain XSS and failed payments when CDN is blocked

Title: National ID not unique
Evidence: national_id has no unique constraint or duplicate detection
Impact: One identity many accounts; fraud rings

Title: Verification does not gate lending
Evidence: Loan apply and payment never check is_verified
Impact: Unverified users can pay and borrow

Title: No liveness or face match
Evidence: Selfie is a static upload; staff eyeball three images

Title: Integer IDs instead of foreign keys
Evidence: Payment.loan_id, Payment.user_id, Transfer.loan_id are plain integers

Title: Status model incomplete and history overwritten
Evidence: Only PENDING/APPROVED/DISBURSED; last_event overwritten each change
Impact: No failed/expired/repaid states; no audit trail
Fix: Full state machine and append-only LoanEvent

Title: Race on active-loan check
Evidence: Check-then-create with no DB constraint or lock
Impact: Two loans, two fees, double payout

Title: Unlimited pending applications
Evidence: Only approved/disbursed with fee paid count as active
Impact: Multiple references and fees per user
Fix: One open application per user; expiry job

Title: full_clean on every save
Evidence: Loan.save calls full_clean; update_fields saves validate unrelated fields

Title: Four phone normalizers with different rules

Fix: One shared utility plus property tests

Title: Migration drift

Title: Nullable payment reference in get_or_create
Evidence: ensure_payment_record_created can receive a null reference

Title: No audit log

Title: No admin for core models
Evidence: No admin.py; User, Loan, Payment, Transfer unregistered

Title: Verification queue cannot scale

Title: Rejected users have no path forward
Evidence: No re-upload endpoint; rejection notes never shown in the UI

Title: No notifications
